descriptor: Contract review software for small legal teams

voice.summary: Clause & Co writes like a careful senior associate explaining a contract over lunch. It is calm and exact, translates legal terms into plain English and never raises an alarm it cannot justify.
dos: Translate each clause in one plain sentence
Say risky, missing or fine, with a reason
donts: Do not use legalese to sound authoritative
Do not use scary red wording for minor issues

taglines: Read every clause. Sign with confidence
Fewer surprises in the small print
boilerplate: Clause & Co is contract review software that flags risky terms, explains them in plain English and tracks each contract from first draft to renewal.

microcopy.success: Report ready. 3 risky clauses and 1 missing term found.
microcopy.error: We could not read that file. Upload a PDF or Word document.
microcopy.empty: No contracts yet. Upload one to review.

logo.note: A shield stands for protection in the small print.
